answer: Sybil resistance here binds each agent to a staked bond plus a slowly accruing reputation score, so a swarm of fresh identities starts from zero and cannot borrow history. Faked identities therefore burn capital with no meadow of easy rewards, and each verified action sends a ripple through the trust graph that peers can audit.
